primary_metric: Median across three counterbalanced repetitions of slowest-host complete measured rollout segment speedup, with every repetition faster and all native useful-work counters equal.
secondary_metrics: process CPU seconds per wall second
scope: Fixed network and fixed 1024 games/host, 32 warmup turns and 128 measured turns, 16 simulations. Each dispatch has128 positions/host. All source/model/native/config identities pinned. Includes completed and unfinished games in the same early-to-mid-game measurement window. No learner is present.
exclusions: No trace hashing or duplicate reference inference during measurement; no other benchmark, native build or evaluation workload launched concurrently. Runtime thread affinity broadening is recorded, not assumed absent.
selection: Async is the only follow-up passing the required exact TPU trace gate. Scan and direct-wide numerical differences remain separate experimental results, not measured as equivalent-work optimizations here.
failure_policy: Stop on any attempt or native-work mismatch and retain all records. No replacement samples in this protocol.
budget: Six bounded attempts; charge all stage/compile/prepare/execute windows and keep total reserved allocation accounting separate.
